The '''''Action Tidings'' Tower''' was a high tower located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ugnorgrad/Legends|Ugnorgrad]] on the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]]. The tower contained the [[Action Tidings studio|''Action Tidings'' studio]] and had a flashing [[holologo]] of ''[[Action Tidings]]'' on top. From the tower, you could see the [[Mechanics Union Auxiliary Meeting Hall|Mechanics Union Hall]].<ref name="Wizards" />
